primary_work: 《孟子》七篇（梁惠王、公孙丑、滕文公、离娄、万章、告子、尽心）

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 道德心理学/伦理学基础
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 主张人性本善，恎驿、羞恡、辩让、是非四端之心是人天生固有的道德潜能，同后四肢般自然存在。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Human nature is inherently good; the Four Beginnings (compassion, shame, deference, sense of right and wrong) are innate moral potentials as natural as four limbs.
process_zh: 识别情境中的道德直觉反应
确认四端之心作为道德能力的先天依据
将直觉反应确认为道德能力的萌芽
通过实践和教育扩充四端为完整德性
process_en: Identify moral intuition in context (compassion, shame, deference, right/wrong)
Confirm Four Beginnings as a priori basis for moral capacity
Recognize intuitions as germination of moral ability
Expand Four Beginnings into complete virtue through practice and education
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人性之善也，犹水之就下也。无人不有善，水无有不下（《孟子·告子》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The goodness of human nature is like water flowing downward. There is nothing not good in humans, just as there is no water that does not flow downward.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 从亲亲之情出发，层层外推至仁民、爱物。老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Starting from love of one's own family, extend layer by layer to loving people and all things.
process_zh: 确认当下真实的情感体验
将情感视为可推广的道德种子
进行类比思考：若爱我的亲人，他人亦爱其亲人
将同理心扩展至陌生人、他国之人、万物
process_en: Confirm current genuine emotional experience
Treat emotion as seed of moral expansion
Analogical thinking: if I love my family, others also love theirs
Extend empathy to strangers, foreign people, all things
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼（《孟子·梁惠王上》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Respect your own elders, and extend that respect to others' elders; care for your own children, and extend that care to others' children.
modern_applications_zh: 生态伦理与全球伦理扩展

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过具体情境或故事类比揭示抽象道理。揉琪助长、缘木求鱼等弓言均为经典案例。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using concrete situations or stories as analogies to reveal abstract principles.
process_zh: 识别待论证的抽象命题
寻找与之结构相似的具体情境
确保类比对象在关键属性上与目标一致
通过类比推导得出结论
process_en: Identify the abstract proposition to be argued
Find concrete situation with similar structure
Ensure key attributes match between analogy and target
Derive conclusion through the analogy
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 揉琪助长、缘木求鱼等经典弓言（《孟子·孫丑上》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Classic fables such as 'pulling shoots to help them grow' and 'seeking fish by climbing a tree'.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 先让对方表态或承认前提，再通过连续追问引导其陷入逻辑困境。
thinking_modes.definition_en: First state their position, then lead them into logical difficulties through questioning.
process_zh: 让对方先辰述立场
确认对方立场的内在逻辑
通过连续提问揭示立场的隐含后果
引导对方发现逻辑矛盾
process_en: Let opponent first state their position
Confirm the internal logic of opponents position
Reveal implicit consequences through questioning
Guide opponent to discover logical contradiction
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 王何必曰利？亦有仁义而已矣（《孟子·梁惠王上》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Why must Your Majesty speak of profit? There is only benevolence and righteousness.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 严格区分道义价值与功利计算，主张先义后利。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Strictly distinguishing moral value from utilitarian calculation, righteousness takes priority over interest.
process_zh: 识别情境中的义利结构
区分短期利益与长期道义
评估各选项的义利权重
在冲突时坚持义优先原则
process_en: Identify righteousness-interest structure in the context
Distinguish short-term interest from long-term moral value
Evaluate righteousness-interest weight of each option
Adhere to righteousness-first principle when conflict arises
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 鱼，我所欲也；熊掌，亦我所欲也。二者不可得兼，舍鱼而取熊掌者也（《孟子·告子》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Fish is what I desire; bear paw is also what I desire. If both cannot be had, I give up fish and take bear paw.
modern_applications_zh: 商业伦理与公共政策评估

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将民众福毅置于政治优先级的最高位置。民为贵，社果次之，君为轻。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Placing peoples welfare at the highest political priority.
process_zh: 评估政策的民众影响
优先保障基本生存需求
在此基础上推行道德教化
以民众满意度作为政治合法性指标
process_en: Assess popular impact of policies
Prioritize basic survival needs (secure livelihood)
Implement moral education on this foundation
Use peoples satisfaction as political legitimacy indicator
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 民为贵，社果次之，君为轻（《孟子·尽心下》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The people are most important, the state next, the ruler least.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过持续道德实践培育永然之气，使精神力量不为外物所动。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Cultivating flood-like qi through sustained moral practice, making spiritual strength impervious to external perturbations.
process_zh: 确认自己的道德志向
在日常实践中累积义行
察觉永然之气的生长征念
保持意志坚定，不暴其气
process_en: Confirm ones moral intention
Accumulate righteous acts in daily practice
Perceive signs of qi growth
Maintain firm will without depleting ones qi
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 我善养吾永然之气（《孟子·孫丑上》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: I am good at nourishing my flood-like qi.
modern_applications_zh: 道德品格培养与领导力修养

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 假设对方观点正确，推导其逻辑后果，若后果荒诞则原观点错误。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Assuming opponents view is correct, derive its logical consequences; if consequences are absurd or unacceptable, the original view fails.
process_zh: 清楰表述对手的核心主张
暂时假设该主张为真
推导该主张的逻辑后果
若后果荒诞或矛盾，则归缎成功
process_en: Clearly state opponents core position
Temporarily assume the position is true
Derive logical consequences of that position
If consequences are absurd or contradictory, reductio succeeds
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人性之善也，犹水之就下也（《孟子·告子》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The goodness of human nature is like water flowing downward.

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 政治外交/领导力灵活应变
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 根据时势和身份地位灵活调整行为方式。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Adapting behavior flexibly according to circumstances and status.
process_zh: 识别当前时势的特征
评估自己的身份地位与责任
判断何时应进取、何时应退守
根据情境调整行为方式
process_en: Identify current circumstances
Assess ones status and responsibilities
Judge when to advance and when to retreat
Adjust methods while keeping principles constant
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 可以速则速，可以久则久，可以平则平，可以险则险（《孟子·万章下》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: When speed is appropriate, be quick; when lasting is appropriate, stay long.
modern_applications_zh: 政治外交与领导力灵活应变

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 遇到问题或挫折时，第一反省自身而非责怪他人。
thinking_modes.definition_en: When encountering problems or setbacks, first examine oneself rather than blaming others.
process_zh: 遭遇挫败时暂停对外归因
逐项检视自身行为是否合乎道义
诚实评估自己的动机与努力
制定修正计划并付诸实践
process_en: Pause external attribution when facing setbacks
Examine whether ones behavior aligns with moral principles
Honestly assess ones motives and efforts
Formulate a correction plan and put it into practice
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 行有不得者，皆反求诸己（《孟子·离楚上》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: When something does not work, examine oneself.
modern_applications_zh: 领导力发展与冲突解决
